splashCongrats: Congratulations on becoming a Top Circle member!
introBody: As one of our valued members, you deserve something special. We're excited to introduce the exclusive benefits and personalized services waiting for you!
birthdayBody: Enjoy platform-wide promotion, a birthday avatar frame, and 3 days of SVIP privileges.
giftBody: Apply for one free personalized static gift made just for you.
careIntro: Our Top Circle Member Care Team is reaching out to stay connected with you and learn more about your Niki experience.
eligBody: Actively participate in our conversations and answer our questions to receive an exclusive Top Circle Avatar Frame!
scheduleBody: Every Monday (UTC+8). Conversations completed on Monday will receive their rewards the following Monday.
